title: 第19章 赶尽杀绝第20章 凯旋回城
slug: 成为女帝炉鼎我踏上了无敌路
content_zh:
“他们好像动不了了。”
“绝对是啊！
趁他虚，要他命！”
“你去杀了他俩，为大王报仇，扬名立万……”
几头妖兽交谈着，一步步朝李易和李凡兄弟俩走来，眼里带着许些畏惧，许些兴奋。
“你们这群胆小鬼，要杀他俩就赶紧，别给他俩恢复时间。”
一头独角魔狼从山洞深处窜出来，迅疾如风，眼里满是狠辣，扑向软倒在地的李易。
“哥……”
李凡一脸焦急，挣扎着起身，奈何他全身骨骼断裂太多，内脏破损，根本来不及营救。
“为我父亲陪葬吧。”
高达三米的独角魔狼狞笑着，一脚踏向李易的脸庞，它要以这种羞辱的姿态杀死李易，才能消除内心的仇恨。
下一刻，它的笑容凝固了，眼神开始涣散，一把明晃晃的长剑，贯穿了它的脑袋。
“真以为我一点力气都没有了吗？”
李易缓缓站起，浑身是血，如同一个浴血修罗，眼神冰冷无情，扫视四方的妖兽，寒声道：“我说过，一个不留！”
话毕。
天剑在他的操控下，犹如一条灵活的蛇，在空中穿行，所过之处，鲜血飚射，兽首跌落。
“快逃啊，这人是恶魔。”
“呜呜……救命啊，谁来救救我们……”
惨叫声，求饶声不绝于耳。
自魔狼王，四臂猿猴死后，再无一头妖兽是李易的一合之敌，一只只妖兽倒地，无论老少，无论公母，尽皆死于天剑之下，无一活命！

“这是剑仙吗？”
关押一百孩童的牢笼里，有个四五岁的小女童异于常人，没有吓得埋头躲着，反而趴在牢笼边，双眼放光，充满崇拜地盯着浑身是血的李易。
“大侠，饶命啊，我和你是同胞。”
一名官员见天剑飞来，吓得尿了裤子，扑通一下跪倒在地，战战兢兢求情。
“我没有率兽食人的同胞。”
李易眼神冰冷，天剑划过，那官员便带着惊恐死去，没多久，山洞里的妖兽死光了，尸横遍野，血流成河。
“小凡，你服下这颗丹药，然后去取妖兽内丹，真血炼体，我去释放那些孩子。”
李易看向弟弟李凡，见他还能走动，放下心来，抛给他一颗圣丹，自己再吞下一颗，便径直走向山洞角落处的铁牢，里面关着一百个童男童女，他们还活着。
“好。”
李凡服下圣丹，眼里泛起兴奋，强忍着全身疼痛，用灵器小刀将三阶和四阶妖兽腹中的内丹取出，真血装好，这些都是炼体的好资源。
李易来到铁牢处，眼神一凝，盯着旁边的大灶台，喝道：“滚出来。”
“唉，看来还是躲不过。”
一名文士打扮的瘦小中年人，灰头土脸从灶台内爬了出来。
李易认出文士的官府衣服，讥讽道：“万人之上的主簿，为了活命，躲入灶台，你可真是丢人。”
文士拍了拍头上的烟灰，自嘲一笑，“为了活下来，我苟且偷生了三十多年，现在这点屈辱又算得了什么。”
“很可惜，你最终还是难逃一死。”
李易眼神变冷，他不会放过任何一个与妖兽同流合污的人。
文士问道：“你难道就不想知道城主为何要与魔狼王勾结？不想知道连云山有什么秘密吗？”
“不想，我只想杀了你。”
李易扬起了手中的玄器长剑。

“别，别，我是被迫的，我也没有杀过一个人啊，我只是一介凡人，城主要为恶，要与妖兽勾结，还封锁所有向上层官府通报和投诉的通道，我为了家人活命，没办法啊。”
文士一脸恐惧，连忙举手求饶。
“行，将你所知道的一切告诉我，看够不够我饶你一命。”
李易将一个个孩子从牢笼里抱出，有的已经吓昏过去，有的吓得小脸煞白，只有一个小女孩大眼睛很明亮，好奇地盯着李易，问道：“大哥哥，你是剑仙吗？”
content_en:
"They can't seem to move."
"Absolutely!
Take advantage of his weakness and kill him! "
"You go and kill them, avenge the king, and become famous..."
Several monster beasts were chatting and walking towards brothers Li Yi and Li Fan step by step, with a little fear and a little excitement in their eyes.
"You cowards, if you want to kill them, hurry up and don't give them time to recover."
A one-horned demon wolf sprang out from the depths of the cave, as fast as the wind, with ruthless eyes, and pounced on Li Yi, who was lying softly on the ground.
"Brother..."
Li Fan looked anxious and struggled to get up. However, his bones were too broken and his internal organs were damaged, so there was no time to rescue him.
"Bury with my father."
The three-meter-tall one-horned demon wolf smiled ferociously and stepped on Li Yi's face. It wanted to kill Li Yi with this humiliating gesture in order to eliminate the hatred in its heart.
The next moment, its smile froze, its eyes began to blur, and a bright long sword penetrated its head.
"Do you really think I have no strength at all?"
Li Yi stood up slowly, covered in blood, like a bloody Shura, with cold and ruthless eyes, scanning the monsters in all directions, and said in a cold voice: "I said, leave no one behind!"
Finished.
Under his control, the Heavenly Sword was like a flexible snake, traveling through the air. Wherever it passed, blood spurted out and the beast's head fell.
"Run away, this man is a devil."
"Uuwu... help, someone come and save us..."
Screams and begging for mercy were endless.
Since the death of the Demonic Wolf King and the Four-Armed Ape, no demonic beast has been Li Yi's enemy. Each demonic beast fell to the ground, young and old, male and female, all died under the Heavenly Sword, and no one survived!
"Is this the Sword Immortal?"
In the cage where a hundred children were imprisoned, there was a little girl of four or five years old who was different from ordinary people. Instead of hiding in fear, she lay beside the cage, her eyes shining, staring with admiration at Li Yi, who was covered in blood.
"Hero, please spare my life, you and I are compatriots."
When an official saw the Heavenly Sword flying towards him, he was so frightened that he peed his pants and fell to his knees, trembling and begging for mercy.
"I have not led beasts and cannibals of my compatriots."
Li Yi's eyes were cold, and the heavenly sword passed by, and the official died in fear. Not long after, all the monsters in the cave were dead, corpses were everywhere, and blood flowed into rivers.
"Xiaofan, take this elixir, then go get the demonic beast's inner elixir, refine your body with true blood, and I'll release those children."
Li Yi looked at his younger brother Li Fan and saw that he could still move around. He felt relieved and threw him a holy pill. He swallowed another one and walked straight to the iron prison in the corner of the cave. There were a hundred boys and girls locked inside. They were still alive.
"Okay."
Li Fan took the holy elixir, his eyes filled with excitement, and he endured the pain all over his body. He used a spiritual weapon knife to take out the inner elixir from the belly of the third-level and fourth-level monsters, and filled it with true blood. These are good resources for body refining.
Li Yi came to the iron prison, stared at the large stove next to him, and shouted: "Get out."
"Oh, it seems I can't escape."
A thin, middle-aged man dressed as a scribe climbed out of the stove with a gray face.
Li Yi recognized the official clothes of the scribe and said sarcastically: "The chief scribe who is more than ten thousand people, in order to survive, you hide in the stove, you are really shameful."
The scribe patted the cigarette ashes on his head and laughed at himself, "In order to survive, I have lived an ignoble existence for more than thirty years. Now this humiliation is nothing."
"It's a pity that you still have to die in the end."
Li Yi's eyes turned cold. He would not let anyone go who was in cahoots with the monster.
The scribe asked: "Don't you want to know why the city lord colluded with the Demon Wolf King? Don't you want to know what secrets Lianyun Mountain has?"
"No, I just want to kill you."
Li Yi raised the mysterious sword in his hand.
"Don't, don't, I was forced. I have never killed anyone. I am just a mortal. The city wants to do evil. It colludes with monsters and blocks all upwards.There is no channel for reporting and complaining to the local government. I have no choice but to save my family. "
The scribe looked frightened and quickly raised his hands to beg for mercy.
“Okay, tell me everything you know, and I’ll spare your life if it’s enough. "
Li Yi took the children out of the cage one by one. Some had fainted from fear, and some were so frightened that their faces turned pale. There was only one little girl with bright eyes. She stared at Li Yi curiously and asked: "Brother, are you a sword fairy?" "
